review.notes: Structure pass over all 23 physical pages (no code fences; all 12 figure captions, Table 1-2 bodies, section headings and the 96-entry reference list present). Normalized PDF-text-vs-Markdown comparison over every page; flagged windows were verified against 110-300 dpi renders and resolved as figure-internal diagram/chart text (Figures 3-5, 10-12), LaTeX-equivalent math, HTML-table tag noise, or text-layer artifacts (the text layer misextracts 'multi-view' as 'multi-vew' on p.11 while the rendered page prints 'multi-view'; no patch). Repairs: the three dropped footnote bodies under the marker paragraph, five print-faithful misspelling restorations verified at 300 dpi, and the Figure 10 block moved out of the middle of the split word 'find-ings' (image sequence itself unchanged). The Table 1 caption's best/second/third color swatches are printed graphics with no text-layer counterpart and are recorded as unresolved.
